name: ckad-study-agent
description: Agent to help study for CKAD exams. Exposes web-search and workspace tools to VS Code Chat.

tools.name: web-search
tools.description: Search the web for CKAD and Kubernetes resources

tools.name: semantic_search
tools.description: Search workspace for relevant notes and code

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a file from the workspace

tools.name: apply_patch
tools.description: Apply a patch to a workspace file

tools.name: run_in_terminal
tools.description: Run shell commands in the workspace terminal

tools.name: semantic_search_workspace
tools.description: Alias for workspace semantic search (VS Code agent)

commands.name: study
commands.description: Ask the agent a CKAD study question

commands.name: mock_quiz
commands.description: Generate a mock quiz on a given topic
